method: Re-ranked after docs/eo/PILOT_GEOMETRY_AUDIT.md. Evaluated the newly-ingested 'large-commercial-forests' estates (BFC, 3x NFC plantations, 9 others) as candidates and did NOT promote any of them: unknown-precision reported-point geometry (explicitly not the original polygon, per the ingestion's own metadata) plus attribute data that is self-labeled 'Dummy functional test data' or an empty unpopulated template for all 13 records, with zero real measured forestry attributes found. Newness of canonical ingestion (2026-09-05) is not evidence of data quality; the underlying source content is unchanged dummy data from an old commit. See audit section B for the full evidence trail.

calibration_pilots.definition: EO <-> field relationships, observation-operator analysis, temporal matching, information-value analysis. Requires high-confidence spatial support AND strong field evidence AND acceptable temporal compatibility.
calibration_pilots.status: EMPTY. No site in this repository currently satisfies all three requirements simultaneously -- the Tanzania sites have real field measurements but only MEDIUM_CONFIDENCE point geometry of unstated precision/meaning; the Uganda CFRs have HIGH_CONFIDENCE polygon geometry but zero field measurements. This is stated plainly rather than forcing a downgraded site into this class.

engineering_pilots.definition: EO providers, recipes, acquisition geometry, runtime, source availability, worker/job behaviour. Can tolerate weaker biological metadata -- used to prove the pipeline works, not to draw biological conclusions.

sites.reason: Real canonical polygon (656-CFR cohort), already validated end-to-end for S2 and S1 (ee-oyugijason). No field measurements exist or are expected for Uganda CFRs -- not eligible for calibration_pilot regardless of geometry quality.
